snippet.title: The Vigilante Diaries | Announcement trailer - An Out of the Blue Story
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2841600/The_Vigilante_Diaries/

After two tours of duty in the Vietnam War, a working-class man returns to his hometown, to face a city now ravaged by crime, corruption, and social inequality. In this situation, there is only one way out for a lonely and desperate man…

This narrative adventure with decision-making and RPG touches will take us to the United States of the mid-80s. The unhappiness is reflected on the streets. With the people frustrated and a part of society taking advantage of it, our protagonist will deliver justice… in his own way. The player will decide which moral limits they want to cross to survive and protect those around them.

Launching on Nintendo Switch and Steam in 2024.
